integrity: The continuum proof uses an exact dihedral reduction, the supporting-functional characterization of Birkhoff--James orthogonality, a quotient-distance determinant formula, and a complete treatment of the edge and vertex normal-cone cases. The bundled computation is a supplementary symbolic and sampling check, not a replacement for the analytic proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact value is proved only for the regular octagonal plane. No all-regular-polygon formula and no optimal parameter for the distinct C-approximate symmetry relation are claimed.
title: Exact Dragomir symmetry parameter of the regular octagonal Banach plane
